description: Today's Your day brief as it was written this morning: the Do list (each person, who they are to the user, why now, its state: 'ready' to send, 'question' waiting on one answer, or 'headsup' to read, the drafted note and what the user already decided on it), the Know lines, Coming up, What ran, and the page link, and `brand`: today's LinkedIn post and up to three conversations worth joining, each with a drafted comment. Pass `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) for an earlier day. Pass `person` (a name, email or Brain object id) to get every item about that person from the last seven days of briefs instead. Call this for 'what do I need to do today?' and 'what's on my plate?' before anything else, and answer with the Do list first. Read-only: it never runs the brief again.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

person.description: A name, email or Brain object id; returns that person across the last week.

name: my_day
title: Your day
